text: Amazi nemoto ayahlukana ngokuthi siqhagamshelwe kwiikhaleezi zethu.
Ngwana o tla kgona go ithuta go nyanya ka pela gomme se se tla go thuša gore o dire matutu a mantšhi.
Maphodisa ba ka se atlege ka ntle le tšhomišano ya setšhaba.
Ndiye ndizixelela qho kusasa ukuba ndibalisa ibali lam; kunye nendlela endikwazi ngayo ukutya kwesiZulu.
Sikhalela ukuthi uhulumeni uzokwazi ukwenza konke okufanele ukuze amalimi athuthukise, njengoba imali yomphakathi ingasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa izinkinga zikamphakathi.

Sikhona kwi-ofisi ya masipala, kumele sithole amazwi anguMengameli ngokuhusiana nezinqubomgomo zikaRhulumente, izinqubomgomo ezizokuthuthukisa ukuthuthukiswa kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, kuzobhebhetheka ekuthuthweni kwemisebenzi yezwe, kanye nezindlela zokuthuthukisa ubutho bamaZulu naseNingizimu Afrika yonke.

Ngonyaka ophelileyo, i-SARS iqale ukubamba uphicotho-zincwadi lwendlela yokuphila olungama-25 oluxabisa ngaphezulu kwezigidi zeerandi ezingama-450 ukusombulula ukunga ngqinelani phakathi kwengeniso echaziweyo kunye nendlela yokuphila yomntu, olu phicotho-zincwadi lubandakanyangwa kwiinkoliso zokufundisa ezingaphaya kwa-25 000. Lendlela yokuphila iqheliswe kwiingxoxo eziliqhayo phakathi kwezifundo zomntwana, abantu abadala, ezifundisweni, abaphathi bezifundo, abafundi, abaxhasi, abantu abahluphekayo, kunye nabahleli beziqonga. I-SARS iqinisekile ukuthi kule ndlela yokuphila izakulisekisa abantu ngokucopheleleyo, ikwaliwa ph
Boetapele le bašomi ba SARS ba tlo lebogišwa ka mošomo wa bona.
Ke le lakaletša tše botse ka moka mo ngwageng wo ge o ntše o tšwelapele.
Moemedi wa Setheo sa Tlhabollo ya Di-kgwebopotlana oThusa batho ba ba lwelwa ke koloto.
Amabhizinisi yiwona akha amathuba omsebenzi.

Kweli phulo lilijolise ekuthatheni indawo yezikolo ezibeka esichengeni ukhuseleko lwabafundi kunye nabasebenzi, ngenxa yokunqongophala kweziseko zophuhliso ezifanelekileyo, amanzi, ucoceko kunye nombane, kule maphandle ezibhekene nabafundi nobasebenzi, kufuneka kukhuseleke kwabo kwiindawo zokufunda nezosebenzi.
Impilo yethu ihlala ibe njengemvula, ikhanyisa kwingingqi kodwa ikhanyisa njalo.
Ho boloka hlobo ya lerato la mmele mo thekgnong ya mmele, o swanetše go ja dinamelo tše dibotse tša firi le tša mmala.
Bašomi ba bantši ba lahlegetšwe ke letseno ka ge diiri tša bona tša go šoma di ile tša swanelwa ke go fokotšwa mola ba bangwe ba bantši ba ile ba swanelwa ke go fokotšwa mešomong.

Kuzalwa komthonyama wokufunda ngokweluleka kanye nezinyathelo zokuvikela ukudla kwezilwane ezinomlhaza, izwe lithembele kuhlelo lokulingana nezocansi kanye nezinyathelo zokulwisana nezilwane zokudla, ngokomthonyama wokufunda kwesinye isikhathi kanye nezocansi zokuziphatha komthonyama wezempilo.
Badiri ba ba lwantšhang go tšwa go feta ka matšatši a mabedi a tlago, tšhelete ya manzi le merogo e tla oketšwa.

Re lekile ka fao re ka kgo nang go fediša ditlamorago tša dikiletšo tša mesepelo ka go latelana go lebeletšwe mekgwa yeo batho ba iphedišago ka yona, go se dire bjalo re be re sena kgetho ge e se fela go ipea  kotsing ya go welwa ke leuba le lengwe gape leo go ka kgona galago gore le be le šoro kudu ebago leuba la bohloki le la tlala kamoso.
Maendeleo ya jamii huanza na
Kukho izinto ezingezona ezilanga izandiso ezinconywa ngokucekuza ukusetyenziswa kwayo kwimihla ngemihla, kudala ukuba abantu bazifumanele ngokwenzekileyo.
Kwathi ngowezi-2018, sibambe ingqungquthela yokuqala yotshalomali, esingekade mnyango wokukhankasa imali yethu, esingaphezulu kwezigidi ezi-R1.2, esifuna ukutshalomali kweminyaka emininzi.
Re kwele ka mo dihlongwa tše ntši tša setšhaba le dikhamphani tša mmušo di ilego tša dirwa ka boomo gore di fokole.
Izimali zokulondolozwa kubantu bazibambile kakhulu ngemigwaqo yezokuthutha izimali, isiqinisekiso sokuthola imali kubantu abahluphekile kanye nezindlela zokufika kwi-ofisi zokulondolozwa.
Umnotho wethu nomphakathi wethu bakhahlamezeke kakhulu.

Bašomi ba mmalwa ba mmušo mo mengwageng ba be ba tšea gore go lokile go dira kgwebo le mmušo goba go holega go tšwa go mmušo go dumeletšwe go bona, ba gwera ba bona le go malapa a bona, ge fela ba sa tshele molao.
Re gopola bašomedi ba rena ba tša maphelo bao ba lobilego maphelo a bona ba hlokometše balwetši.
Ugumbi lokuncelisela loluwa nguNgqongqoshe wezempilo kulesisifundazwe. Abantu bamakhosi baya kwenye ingumbi zikaRheli yakho ezempilo ezingaphakade.
